experiment: STARTS S1C: frozen fresh-dev confirmation of PR83 S1 vs S4 at N12 and N15

hypothesis.one_sentence: The PR83 TQA-concentration win vs four-start C0 generalizes to eight fresh development instances at N12 and at N15, with recipes frozen.
hypothesis.not: No K/gain/start retune. No S2. No S8. No continuation. Fair S1 Nov3 vs QAOA energy remains a separate claim from S1 vs S4.

frozen_from_PR83.optimizer: ordinary IID Rademacher SPSA C0, ncal=4, A=25, live per-start gain, last+Polyak, energy min

seeds.collision_check: no instance/run filenames; 10048-55 are PR82/83 read-dev; 10036-43 DEPTH; 10032-47 LEXACT; 10018-25 FT; 10026-31 local; 10010-17 N3COND; 11000-11031 validation; 20000-20999 final

allocation.S1: One start = TQA. Full Q=3072, K=1531. Same C0 RNG stream as S4 start 0.
allocation.S4: Four equal C0 starts, K=379. Fitted on these seeds, charged. Not reused from 10048-55.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F diagnostic only, never selects.

gate.metric: bootstrap 95% CI of mean(E_S1 - E_S4) for Nov3, n=accepted seeds
gate.pass: CI entirely below 0 at N12 AND at N15
gate.fail_if: either size has CI that includes or exceeds 0, or that size has no accepted fits
report_regardless: paired means/CIs/tails S1-S4 energy and F
fair Nov3 vs QAOA energy and F under S1 and under S4
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if the gate passes. Confirmation is not adoption.
